from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import re,json,sys
D=Path('.orchestration/dotfiles-T133-task-generator-plan-check-a06-checker')
def parse(name):
    text=(D/name).read_text()
    pairs=re.findall(r'^={70}\n(FAIL|ERROR): (.+)\n-{70}\n',text,re.M)
    ctr=Counter(pairs)
    foot=re.findall(r'^Ran (\d+) tests? in ([0-9.]+)s$',text,re.M)
    assert len(foot)==1,(name,foot)
    summary=re.findall(r'^FAILED \((.+)\)$',text,re.M)
    assert len(summary)==1,(name,summary)
    stats={k:int(v) for k,v in re.findall(r'(failures|errors|skipped)=(\d+)',summary[0])}
    assert sum(v for (kind,_),v in ctr.items() if kind=='FAIL')==stats.get('failures',0)
    assert sum(v for (kind,_),v in ctr.items() if kind=='ERROR')==stats.get('errors',0)
    return {'log':name,'tests':int(foot[0][0]),'seconds':float(foot[0][1]),**stats,'tuple_occurrences':[{'kind':k,'test':n} for k,n in pairs],'tuple_multiplicities':[{'kind':k,'test':n,'count':v} for (k,n),v in sorted(ctr.items())]},ctr
base,bc=parse('full-unit-base.log')
candidate,cc=parse('revision1-final-full-unit-candidate.log')
exitdata=json.loads((D/'revision1-final-full-unit-exit.json').read_text())
def records(c):
    return [{'kind':k,'test':n,'count':v} for (k,n),v in sorted(c.items())]
result={'fixed_base':'60a6fb2b324d0381c4a6e539b37c650105154a7e','candidate_snapshot':json.loads((D/'revision1-final-full-suite-snapshot.json').read_text())['snapshot_commit'],'code_bindings':json.loads((D/'revision1-final-bindings.json').read_text()),'baseline_actual_exit':2,'candidate_actual_exit_record':exitdata,'parser':r'^={70}\n(FAIL|ERROR): (.+)\n-{70}\n with re.M; Counter preserves repeated subtest tuples; footer/header counts asserted','baseline':base,'candidate':candidate,'candidate_minus_base':records(cc-bc),'base_minus_candidate':records(bc-cc),'new_failure_occurrences':sum((cc-bc).values()),'removed_failure_occurrences':sum((bc-cc).values()),'classification':'Exact local comparison, not a green full suite or final-head Linux CI evidence.'}
(D/'revision1-final-full-unit-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['candidate_snapshot','candidate_minus_base','base_minus_candidate','new_failure_occurrences','removed_failure_occurrences']},ensure_ascii=False))
print(json.dumps({'baseline':{k:v for k,v in base.items() if not k.startswith('tuple')},'candidate':{k:v for k,v in candidate.items() if not k.startswith('tuple')}}))

## Complete numstat

    old=((D/'full-diff-inventory.json').read_bytes(),(D/'measure.md').read_bytes())
